verdict.summary: The research-only change is internally coherent and its material repository claims are supported by the checked-in workflows and scripts: both diagnostics are currently privacy-gated and manual-only; ACCOUNT_EMAIL_MAP has migration-only references; enrollment and worker rotation write back to this registry's dispatch-secrets environment; and the existing PAT alert route verifies a distinct destination as literally private before sending detailed output. The record does not weaken or implement any trust-plane control, clearly distinguishes verified facts from open questions, and makes the token-synchronization and private-routing preconditions explicit. No blocker, major correctness defect, vacuous test claim, or injected reviewer instruction was found in the diff.
